src/lib/components/DashECharts.react.js.description:
Apache ECharts chart for Dash.
The chart code is only loaded when a chart is displayed.

JavaScript functions (formatters, ...) are not sent from Python: define them in an
app asset as `window.dashEchartsFunctions = {name: function}` and reference them in
`option` or `option_merge` with `{"function": "name"}`. With
`{"function": "name", "args": ...}`, the registered function is a factory called
with `args` that returns the function to use.

id.description: The ID used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

className.description: CSS class of the chart container.

style.description: Style of the chart container. It needs a height, e.g. {"height": "400px"}.

option.description: ECharts option. Each change replaces the whole chart option.

option_merge.description: Option merged into the current chart option, to update only some parts.

theme.description:
ECharts theme: the name of a registered theme (e.g. "dark") or a theme object.
Changing it re-creates the chart.

renderer.description: Rendering engine. Changing it re-creates the chart.

actions.description:
ECharts actions dispatched each time this list is set,
e.g. [{"type": "dataZoom", "start": 0, "end": 50}].

y_axis_range.description: Sets the range of a y axis and resets the dataZoom attached to it.

reset_count.description: Increment to clear the chart and draw `option` again.

click_mode.description:
"series": clicks on chart elements are reported in click_data.
"grid": any click inside a grid is reported with its coordinates
(x, y, and xCategory for a category x axis).

events.description:
Names of other ECharts events to report in event_data,
e.g. ["legendselectchanged", "brushSelected"].

n_clicks.description: Number of clicks reported in click_data.

click_data.description: Last click (see click_mode), with a timestamp.

zoom_data.description: Last dataZoom change: dataZoomId, start, end (in %), startValue, endValue, timestamp.

axis_right_click_data.description:
Last right-click on an axis whose triggerEvent is true:
axis ("xAxis" or "yAxis"), index, name, seriesName, displayed min and max, timestamp.

event_data.description: Last event listed in `events`: its ECharts parameters, type and timestamp.

setProps.description:
Dash-assigned callback that should be called to report property changes
to Dash, to make them available for callbacks.
